Concept ads

Concept work for ARC. These ads have not run and have no performance data. They show how I build a test set around the copy: a headline, a proof line and a call to action.

Three angles, one layout

Only the headline and proof line change, so a test shows which message wins.

One ad, three placements

The first ad adapted to a story, a feed post and a landscape placement. The wordmark, colors and hierarchy stay the same.

Round two: iterating on a winner

If "one of a kind" won the first test, this is how I would build the next round. One variable changes at a time: layout, color, then angle.

Concept presentation

Concept work for ARC. A short webinar deck, to show how I handle slides: one idea per slide, large type, and a clear next step.

My day job is building presentations and learning material for corporate training, so this is work I do every day. Client examples are confidential.

About

I'm a designer and a corporate learning and development specialist. I created the brand for ARC, an art gallery in Egypt, and I design presentations and learning material every day.

My work is about making information easy to take in. I'm comfortable with UI/UX fundamentals, and I care about hierarchy, clear copy and consistency across every format a brand uses.

Presentations
I build presentations and learning material every day, so decks and slides are routine work for me.
Brand materials

Clear communication

Ad design

UI/UX fundamentals
I understand the basics of interface and user experience design.
